Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1020
Claimant:
Heather Madden
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
04/11/2024
The claimant reported that a vehicle sideswiped their car while changing lanes on a multi-lane road, and the claim
was opened the same day. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer and has been handling the claim directly.
05/07/2024
The driver is named on the policy, and the coverage was confirmed as active at the time of the reported loss. Nothing
in the records suggests the damage existed before coverage started.
06/09/2024
Photos submitted by the claimant show scrapes and a dented rear quarter panel along the driver side. The damage
pattern is consistent with the impact described in the first report.
06/13/2024
Police confirmed the claimant was in the vehicle when the report was filed at the scene. No independent witnesses
have come forward to date.
06/17/2024
The claimant reported a concussion with headache and dizziness following the collision. The reported injury appears
to match the kind and force expected from a sideswipe of this type.
07/04/2024
The claimant described the events in the same way during the initial call, the written statement, and the follow-up
interview. The account has remained consistent across every conversation.
07/13/2024
A check of available records found no prior damage to the vehicle in the same areas. No earlier repair history has
been identified that would account for the current damage.
08/17/2024
The claimant was referred for medical evaluation and began a standard course of treatment for head injury. The
treatment followed a typical progression for this type of injury.
11/06/2024
A review of medical history found no earlier injury to the head or neck area. Nothing in prior records suggests a
pre-existing condition affecting the current claim.
11/11/2024
The claimant reported steady improvement over the following weeks, with headaches becoming less frequent.
Treatment visits tapered off as the symptoms resolved, which fits the expected recovery pattern.
11/27/2024
The vehicle damage estimate was reviewed against the photos and the described impact, and the two align. The
estimate has been approved for repair pending final supplement review.
11/29/2024
Based on the consistent account, the confirmed coverage, the photos, the police report, and the medical records, the
claim is progressing toward resolution. No further information is needed at this time.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
